reason: V6: raw busy/done/fault/uop_v/uop_pc and tap_iteration are flop Q (programme-target feedback at host_v4 edges); uop_d1 (to the uop pipe leaf) and busy_d2/start_d2 (protocol leaf) / busy_d3/done_d3/start_d3 (others) are the leaf's own delay flops; tap_steps is the bank face flop AND uop_v captured by the protocol leaf's pin flops; cfg/start/start_pc land in control flops. A synthesis pin stage would add edges the V6 schedule and bench do not carry.
